## Poll GitHub Actions for bizOS failures

Runs every 15 minutes. Requires `GITHUB_TOKEN` in n8n env (fine-grained PAT or classic token with `actions:read` on pmwasim/bizOS).

Works with **localhost n8n** — no inbound webhook from GitHub required.

Dedupes by workflow run id in workflow static data. Replace **Log Route** with Slack/email before activation.

meta.description: Polls GitHub Actions for new bizOS failures. Configure GitHub API Token credential before activation.
